posts.heading: September 14, 2026
posts.text:
The morning began with a Blue Jay perched on the ground near the nectar source thirteen minutes after sunrise, immediately followed by a Tufted Titmouse taking the tube feeder at 07:38. Carolina Wrens called constantly.

Total visits reached 159 across 16 species, compared to the typical 39 at this hour. Tufted Titmice recorded 64 confident visits, while Carolina Chickadees contributed 46. Carolina Wrens registered 160 detections and Northern Cardinals 48, exceeding the recent daily average of 87 sounds. Eastern Towhees and Northern Mockingbirds also registered.
